_readme: Tuning knobs for the Organic Brief (scripts/build_brief.py). Edit and re-run; no code changes needed. Keys starting with _ are comments.

output._readme: Brief is written next to the Detail Pack (index.html) at the repo root as <prefix><YYYY-MM-DD>.html, date = the data file's week-end date.

scoreboard._readme: Engagement rate = interactions / denominator. 'impressions' uses views_by_channel (always available); 'reach' uses the sum of social_posts[].reach per platform (only if the run wrote social_posts).
scoreboard._top_channel_readme: Slide 1 title 'Our top channel this week was X' picks the platform with the highest value of this metric: impressions | er | followers_gained | posts | reach.

social_wins._readme: Top posts of the week, read from the data file's social_posts array. rate = sort_metric / denominator_metric. Posts with denominator below min_denominator are skipped so a 3-view post with 2 likes can't win.

gmb_top_properties._readme: Score = sum(weight * metric) over gbp_by_property. Highest score wins. Metrics shown on the slide are the weighted ones, in this order.

url_tracking._readme: Which GA4 field counts as 'clicks' and which as 'leads' for each source. max_property_rows caps the by-property table (rows with any activity, sorted by leads then clicks).
